label: SQLite backup file format
type: one of cbbackupmgr's two backup-archive file formats, alongside backup:rift-backup-format. Inspected via tool:cbsqlitedump. Supports key-deduplication during merge (identical keys across merged backup files are deduplicated into a single smaller file), unlike the Rift format.
evidence: with the SQLite format it will deduplicate identical keys in backup files merged together in order to create a single smaller backup file.
cbsqlitedump is used to dump SQLite files generated by cbbackupmgr.
relates_to_competency_question: Which backup file format supports key-deduplication during a merge, and how would an administrator verify that on disk?
